title: Access-token claims
description: The JWT both apps receive from the auth service (RS256/ES256, verified against its JWKS). Carries identity and org roles only. Workspace roles are not in the token: apps read them from suite.workspace_memberships at action time (rule 3). Lifetime 5 minutes; apps also consume user.locked / org.member.suspended events to refuse before expiry (rule 5).

sub.description: u_… for a user; sup_… for Keyhole support.

org.description: The org the session is currently acting in (switcher).

orgs.description: Every org membership, for the org switcher. Truncated at 50; orgs_truncated then says so.

mver.description: Membership version: bumps on any role/status change for this user. Apps compare with the cached value from events and re-introspect when behind.

support.description: Keyhole support (superAdmin). sub is then sup_… and orgs is empty; scope limits it to lock, unlock, sign-out-everywhere, resend-invite.
